title: Progress Event Schema
description: Schema for entries in AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl. Each line is a JSON object recording a progress event: agent lifecycle transitions, phase milestones, verifier results, or context compression events.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent that generated this event.

phase.description: Factory phase this event belongs to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this event occurred.

nativeGenerated.description: Whether this progress event was generated during live execution (true) or reconstructed (false).

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence entries (file paths) associated with this event.

verifierName.description: Name of verifier module, if eventType is verifier_*.

targetGate.description: Target gate checked, if eventType is verifier_*.

outcome.description: Outcome of verifier check, if eventType is verifier_*.

compressionLevel.description: Context compression level at time of event.

sessionId.description: Session identifier for the agent session that generated this event.

sequenceNumber.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the agent session.

parentEventId.description: If this event is a child of another event (e.g., repair_completed after verifier_fail), the parent event's identifier.

durationMs.description: Duration of the operation in milliseconds, if applicable.

metadata.description: Additional structured metadata specific to the eventType.
